body_markdown:
### [Test flows from the SDKs with mocked or replaced steps](https://www.windmill.dev/changelog/test-flows-from-the-sdks)


Flow editor


TypeScript


Python


[v1.880.0](https://github.com/windmill-labs/windmill/releases/tag/v1.880.0)


[Docs](https://www.windmill.dev/docs/flows/test_flows#test-a-deployed-flow-from-a-script)


Test scripts can run a deployed flow with some steps overridden, using wmill.testFlow (TypeScript) or wmill.test_flow (Python). An override mocks a step's result or replaces its logic with a function of the test script, steps inside subflows included.


#### New features


- Map a step id to a value to mock its result, or to a function exported from the test script to run that function with the step inputs.
- Name a step inside a subflow by the path of step ids to it, such as sub:inner, at any depth.
- testFlowAsync and test_flow_async return the job id instead of waiting for the result.
- Requires a role with the Write code capability; replacing a step with a function only works from a script running in Windmill.
- The flow's preprocessor does not run and result caching is off for the test run.
